case: built-in macaddr[] binary result, inferred bind, keyed edit, CSV restore and invalid-input refusal
contract: Binary macaddr[] results preserve canonical six-octet values, SQL NULL and non-default lower bounds using the native element OID 829.
Assignment-inferred array parameters encode each valid six-octet element in PostgreSQL binary form; native array_send bytes match after direct and keyed updates.
Typed CSV import restores macaddr[] alongside the existing PostgreSQL array families.
Malformed element lengths and non-hexadecimal octets are refused; the target and sibling rows remain unchanged.
The built-in OID census includes macaddr[] and continues to require explicit refusal for unlisted built-in arrays.
